question: Related Questions Q. My parents bought me a laptop and internet connection which I use for making money as a part time job 3216 views Q. I have a question regarding taxi cabs in Chicago. Is it allowable to tranport drunk passengers? Let me explain you the situation here: During morning shifts(5Am to 5PM) the passengers are mostly those going to office, airport or shopping malls. But during evening shifts, customers are mostly going to Bars/Pubs/strip clubs. There are certain streets which have bars one after the other. Going on those streets means you are going near bars. Also cabbies line up outside famous bars/pubs. If you want to avoid these customers you have to take small streets where you are almost certain of not getting any customers. Then to pick up customers you have to go to office areas which will be very far. After 11PM there is hardly anyone else on the streets other than drunk revelers. Another issue you can consider is that if anyone is trying to flag you down, you cannot refuse them. But that is just a rule and can be conveniently broken. In short avoiding bar areas is feasible but you make 1/3rd of what other people make. 2137 views Q. Is it is necessary to undergo circumcision at later age 3573 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 58794 Country: AF Title: VOIP termination (Restricted from Government) Question: I am going to start a business in Afghanistan. The business is that I would be selling mobile phone minutes to international companies. This business is restricted and is fully not allowed from the Afghanistan government because the government itself is selling international income phone calls to outside companies at higher rate. Suppose the government is selling a minute per 10 rupees I would be selling the same at 7 rupees where I still earn 3 rupees per minute. Is it allowed for me to do this business while the government does not allow it? I have to admit that the money the government generates from this business is spend in the government in different parts like supporting the Afghan police, Afghan Army, roads, public health and so on. If I start this business the government will surely loss some amount since they will less minutes to sell. Kindly let me know if it is permissible to do so. Answer ID: 58794 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 373/373/SD=07/1436) In case the abovementioned business is prohibited by the government yet you do it then you would land yourself in trouble. It is better for you not do the business. You should adopt any other lawful business which involves no legal restriction. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
